name: Preact

hook.title: Preact code, hooks and signals included.
hook.lede: `@pyreon/preact-compat` mirrors Preact's module layout (the root, `/hooks` and `/signals`), so imports from `preact`, `preact/hooks` and `@preact/signals` resolve to it with no edits. Hooks keep Preact's value-and-re-render model; signals keep `.value`.

doesNotCover: `componentDidCatch`, `getDerivedStateFromError`, `getDerivedStateFromProps`, `getSnapshotBeforeUpdate`: class-based error boundaries do not catch. Use the `ErrorBoundary` component.

Nested state across a parent re-render: the parent rebuilds its subtree, so a child's `useState`, `useReducer` and `useRef` reset and `useEffect([])` runs again. `memo` does not stop it; lift the state up.
The plugin aliases `preact`, `preact/hooks`, `preact/jsx-runtime` and `@preact/signals`; `preact/compat` and `@preact/signals-core` are not aliased.
The component hooks of `@preact/signals` (`useSignal`, `useComputed`, `useSignalEffect`) are not exported, so an import of them fails.

config.note: Use it in place of `@preact/preset-vite`. Aliases `preact`, `preact/hooks` and `@preact/signals`.
Types and the JSX runtime come from the compat package.
